decision_limit: No result proves physical light, MCU acceptance, or causation.

observer.qualification: Eligibility requires ordered, wholly in-window human picture annotations with both reaction and clock uncertainty; software is never a physical label source.

physical_state_source: local human annotations only; never software-derived

pre_capture_sync.qualification: TV date has integer-second granularity; uncertainty includes full RTT plus 1s.

process_files.qualification: TIDs are equal before setup, immediately after tracing starts, and at end; FD changes/reuse are reported and targets are not assumed stable.

samples.qualification: userspace raw fields only; no kernel gate or emitted-light state inferred

trace.qualification: The physical/observer and event-inventory window is exactly CAPTURE_START through CAPTURE_END. Syscall54 tracing is limited to the identical validated AVOC START/PRE/ARM/END TID set and remains active through a bounded CAPTURE_DRAIN_END; every traced fork/exit involving that set rejects the run. An AVOC call begun inside the capture window is classified only if its return is recorded before the drain cutoff, with post-END returns identified explicitly; an unresolved in-window or start-crossing call rejects. Drain-only and post-drain rows are excluded and reported. I2C values are syntax-checked raw line inventory only: adapter-5 i2c_result rows are not address-attributed or grouped with messages, so no complete transfer, MCU acknowledgement, acceptance, or physical effect is claimed. Tracepoint absence covers enabled Linux APIs only.

vlog.qualification: Endpoint/order/gap assessment only; generic log absence is never established.
